R12 References and engine constants. Every reference is same-model, same-series: the fold's training up share (to be stored), majority_class_accuracy, buy_and_hold, the sign-shuffled baseline, persistence, or a mathematical constant. brier_skill_score and actual_up_fraction are labelled hindsight. Engine choices are stated in the definition of each metric they touch with their source: gaps over four days removed from bars per year (metrics.py:87), 10 equal-width calibration bins (report.py:66), confidence-bucket edges (report.py:71), the 30-trade note (metrics.py:78). Verdict cut-offs in verdicts.ts are not copied into any record.

R13 Caveats written into the models they attach to: stacked_generalization unpurged KFold (sklearn_adapter.py:498-514); attention_weighted_forecast_stack fitted on validation rows; overlapping horizon targets (intervals use block bootstrap or Newey-West, never a binomial interval); non-MNQ costs are the MNQ figure; the fold's last bar exits at its close; the sampler's refusal gate with its source.

R14 Label kind. Every record describes the default label (label_kind = direction: is the close label_horizon_bars ahead above this bar's close). Under the run setting label_kind = reversal the adapter is fitted on whether the next label_horizon_bars turn against the previous label_horizon_bars and answers the probability of a turn; the engine converts that to the probability of up at each bar (CycleEngine.probability_up: one minus it after an up-move, the same number after a down-move) before anything is scored or traded, so every as-run metric is computed on the converted probability and reads the same way.

R15 Step quantity. step_quantity is null only when an adapter reports no train_loss and no validation_loss at all. A model fitted in one step still reports epoch 1 of 1 with one value of each (cycle/bridges/training.py single_fit; cycle/sklearn_adapter.py), and its step_quantity names what those two values hold.
assignmentRules: A1 Assign by what the model PRODUCES natively, never by folder or adapter name. Read the spec in this order and report the fallback used: Overview, else Definition; Principles, else Algorithm; always Training; then the registry row.

A2 Two fields: profile_id_native and profile_id_as_run (null when not run), plus additional_profile_ids from which only named metrics are copied. architecture_component is only ever additional. A reward-trained model takes an agent profile and its backbone is additional; when a model learns a world model and deploys a policy, the trained signal decides (return through the learned model gives world_model_agent; a model-free update on mixed batches gives policy_agent).

A2b Standing assignments (native / as run): MCMC posterior_sampler + predictive_distribution; mixture_of_experts, hypernetwork, transformer class_probability + architecture_component; capsule_network class_probability with objective capsule_margin_loss; naive_bayes class_probability; random_forest, extra_trees, k-NN, trees vote_share_or_frequency; scenario_analysis multi_criteria_decision_framework / regime_density; fuzzy_decision_model symbolic_rule_reasoner / symbolic_rule_reasoner; symbolic_regression point_forecast; cross-entropy method heuristic_search_optimizer + policy_agent; gradient_descent heuristic_search_optimizer / class_probability; SGD class_probability; Decision Trees (Simulation folder) vote_share_or_frequency with a cross-reference to the influence diagram; adversarial autoencoder and autoencoder-GAN fusion implicit_sample_generator + projection_or_reconstruction; semi-supervised GAN semi_supervised_classifier; semi-supervised clustering cluster_partition / semi_supervised_classifier; masked autoencoder self_supervised_representation + projection_or_reconstruction; siamese metric_learning_retrieval; probabilistic program plus network predictive_distribution + class_probability; greedy and submodular selection approximation_guaranteed_selection; dynamic programming planner_or_decision_solver; Bayesian decision networks and influence diagrams decision_graph_or_utility_model + graphical_or_probabilistic_logic; event-driven simulation path_simulator with the note that the strategy handler's own profile governs the forecast; hypernetwork policy policy_agent + architecture_component; learning to learn by gradient descent meta_agent with the optimisee's final objective as a diagnostic; mixture of exponentials time_to_event; regime_montecarlo_decision regime_density + path_simulator.
A3 A spec with no registry link (19 of 300: 15 reinforcement learning, 3 hybrid, 1 optimisation) gets a native-only record with as_run null and the sentence 'Not run by the Model Cycle.'

A3b A registry model with no spec (regime_montecarlo_decision, catalogSpecId null, another session's staged file) gets a registry-only record with faithful_to_specification no_specification; it is written with that session, not around it.
A4 A spec linked through alsoCatalogSpecIds shares the registry model's as_run block and writes its own native block.

A4b Specs for the same algorithm in two folders share one native block byte for byte (a test asserts it); only as_run differs. The two Variational Autoencoder specs are both explicit_density with additional projection_or_reconstruction.

A5 native.objective_id comes from the objectives registry: the literature objective. as_run.as_run_objective_id records what the runnable adapter minimises. Never paste a formula; if none fits, propose a new objective entry.
A6 target_variable is written in full words, natively and as run. No RET_LOG_1M-style tokens.
A7 Every metrics[].why is rewritten for this model and names its own mechanism. A why equal to the profile sentence, or sharing 60 percent of its tokens, fails validation.
A8 not_applicable includes each metric the spec's current boilerplate table lists that does not apply, by its old display name, with metric_id null when the registry has no such metric.
A9 At most three primary metrics, each valid for THIS member (profiles mark member-specific primaries); a not_computed metric may be primary natively and carries availability not_computed.
A10 No number appears in a why, baseline or note unless it is a model parameter, a registry count or a mathematical constant.

A11 Mandatory sentences where they apply: the unlabelled pool is manufactured by masking; tasks are time blocks; the rule set is cycle_rules.json plus mined rules; an image architecture is reduced to one dimension; the classical centred average is not causal; t-SNE has no out-of-sample transform in the spec; the feature graph's nodes are this instrument's feature columns and its edges are refitted on each fold's training span; whether the world model is action-conditioned and whether it predicts price or latents; pasted chat boilerplate at line 1 is reported.

A12 Validation before a record is accepted: metric ids exist in the registry; type equals the registry's type; as-run ids map to report.DEFINITIONS; profiles exist; additional profiles never include a primary-only conflict; stand_in_note present unless faithful; registry and spec records for the same model agree on objective ids and profile_id_as_run; every model has exactly one faithful_to_specification, probability_source and price_forecast_source.
